about_the_game:
Enter a world where speed and precision determine success in this thrilling 2D pixel art retro platformer. This demo includes the first 20 levels.

Highlights of the full version:

  • 60 challenging levels: Each world features 20 unique levels that will challenge your speedrunner spirit.

  • Retro pixel art: A lovingly crafted look that reinterprets classic platform action.

  • Precise jump ‘n’ run: React lightning fast to traps and obstacles in a single-screen level design.

  • Steam Achievements: Collect achievements and prove your skills in exciting challenges.

  • Epic final boss: Face the ultimate enemy in a battle that will decide the fate of a family.

Experience an adventure full of heart, action, and nostalgia – and let Little Betty: Gold Rush captivate you!
